kernel.law: APERTURE owns source analysis, canonical cursor, scale, ORP, RSVP and voice. READFIELD owns reader projections, marks and experiment receipts.

donors.unit: one addressed source across spatial/temporal projections
FLOW / hold-context / SHEET / LINE↔DISC experimental shell

invariants: source bytes are not copied into experiment receipts
MAP geometry may seek but does not create semantic meaning
marks are host-owned and address the canonical source position
RETURN includes kernel snapshot + host marks/view/experiment state
non_claims: No claim that contact-sheet selection is semantic summarization.
No new state authority beyond the shared APERTURE kernel.
capability: Read one addressed source through temporal focus, context recovery, structural scan, plain source and controlled minimap topology without losing the canonical source position.
next: Use normally. Promote context/marks/map mechanisms into the shared kernel only if ordinary use exposes repeated cross-host value.
